testimonies.label: // TESTIMONIES — WHOSE FACE IS IT?
testimonies.title: The wall of witnesses
testimonies.intro: One sentence. Who do you see in the face the machine was never asked to make? The litany scrolls slowly, like credits for a film nobody cast.
testimonies.empty: No one has spoken yet. Be the first witness.
testimonies.pauseHint: Hover or tap the litany to hold it still.
